# Gramlot Examples 0.3.11 — Nested tree gallery

The gallery uses FramePage/IndexPage and the shared Bag tree. Numbered filesystem
paths define ordering; module Page.title and Markdown headings define captions.
Each folder opens its own hidden `00-index` page, including Markdown-only indexes,
and loads children lazily. Nested routes remain nested in hosted and offline builds.

The gallery has 84 lessons, including tree labels, structured HTML, icons, classes,
scalar values and internal drag between two Bags. Navigation, Code and Settings
use the frame drawers; Inspector belongs to the top bar. Iframe panels retain
their state across selection changes.

Requires the coordinated core update. Upgrade both server integrations for the
new catalogue/staging contract. Database selectors and editor ports are excluded.
